prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in was helpful when placed after adoption selection (+5.5%) or photo upload (+3.3%), but placing it after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Specific redesigns and new screens were helpful, including Stage Layout (+7.1%), Story Scroll Redesign (+7.4%), Desktop Visibility Check (+8.0%), Story Stage Layout (+4.1%), and Interactive Welcome Screen (+14.0%), though many other redesigns showed no clear effect or negative impact.
Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1%), path selection helper hints (+3.5%), and sign-in clarifications (+9.9%) were helpful, whereas sound cues, notification toggles/banners, overlay hints, and troubleshooter screens showed no clear effect.
Copy updates, incentives, and waiting screen progress, tip, or estimated time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on tests that showed no clear effect or caused severe negative drops.
Predictions were too low for several winning tests, predicting negative or modest impact (-8.0% to +2.4%) on changes that ultimately won (+3.3% to +14.0%).

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Grid Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen: Redesign the path selection screen with a clean grid layout presenting companion selection options side by side with visual thumbnails. (why: The choose_path step has a median duration of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating that some users stall when choosing their path. A clear grid layout simplifies comparison.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Mascot Sync Warning Hint: Add an explanatory helper hint below sign-in options clarifying that signing into an existing account restores saved pets, preventing accidental duplicate account creation. (why: Support receives frequent complaints about pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails), showing confusion around account linking.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Preview Confirmation Screen Before Certificate: Add a pet preview confirmation screen immediately before adoption certificate creation so users can review their rendered pet visual. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off in the funnel (64.1% conversion) and support reports custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Redesign for Adoption Certificate Screen: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a framed card layout to elevate the feeling of an official certificate. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 64.1% with long mean times (1017s). Restructuring certificate layout improves visual clarity and completion rates.)
4: [home, redesign] Carousel Layout Redesign for Waiting Screen: Redesign the generation waiting screen into a carousel layout to showcase pet animations while assets load in the background. (why: The home stage (waiting step) has high mean wait time (2336s) and 82.9% conversion; a dynamic carousel visual structure keeps users engaged during generation.)
5: [finish, layout] Split Layout Redesign for Home Intro Screen: Change the home intro screen layout to a split view displaying desktop companion preview on one side and launch actions on the other. (why: The final onboarding step drops to 76.4% completion with a mean time of 5815s. A split layout clearly separates desktop preview from action triggers.)
6: [adoption, copy] Upload Photos Clarity Body Text Update: Update the body text on the photo upload screen with clear lighting and file format recommendations. (why: Support received reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong (3 emails), which often stems from poor photo input quality.)
7: [finish, new_screen] Companion Interaction Modes Screen Before Finish: Insert a new screen before home intro introducing pet behavior modes on the desktop. (why: Users contact support post-onboarding expressing confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet (3 emails).)
8: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Headline Clarification: Update the headline on the story screen to clearly explain that users will create or adopt a desktop companion. (why: The initial choose_path step exhibits extreme mean completion time (514s vs 8s median), signaling initial ambiguity for a subset of users.)
9: [sign_in, layout] Card Layout Redesign for Sign-In Screen: Redesign the sign-in screen to a card layout focusing attention cleanly on authentication options. (why: Sign-in screen stalling or non-appearance accounts for user support tickets (2 emails). A focused card layout prevents rendering bugs on high-res displays.)
